schema: gold_v2: one row per listing (shelf x ASIN seen on search pages 1-2, 2026-10-28). label in/out; code = reason code (rulebook_v1); EX_VARIANT_DUP rows are in-shelf but collapsed into line_id. New code EX_KIDS (ruling 3). pending_gautam lists open question ids from gold_work/questions_for_gautam.json; those rows keep their v1 label until answered. v3: new code EX_HERO_UNNAMED (G-NAME: hero not named in title or brand name). pending_gautam removed; gautam_round2 records the answer that settled a row. override_pending marks CircuLegs (Q4 vs G-NAME). v4: override_pending removed (R3-4); gautam_round3 notes; dose-split lines get ids *_L4xx. v5: new lines from Round 4 flips get ids *_L5xx. v6: new lines from Round 5 flips get ids *_L6xx. v7: new lines from Round 6 splits get ids *_L7xx.
rulebook: SHELF_RULEBOOK.md rulebook_v1.6 (v1.5 + Gautam Round 6 R6-1..R6-3 + R5-4 whole-food settle)
